title: Effective information speed of FourCastNet v1 (AFNO)
model: FourCastNet v1 (AFNO), HuggingFace nvidia/fourcastnet1, loaded strict, validation-passing (t2m +6h wRMSE 2.32 K beats persistence 2.53 K)
protocol: Single localized t2m Gaussian poke (sigma=500 km, cos-lat zero-mean), one 6 h autoregressive step; response = sqrt(sum_ch (M(x+eps p)-M(x))^2); numerical control M(x)-M(x) is exactly 0, so any nonzero response is real model influence.
reach_note: The response is nonzero at EVERY grid point on Earth after one 6 h step; max reach equals the antipodal distance (the farthest point on the planet). rel_thr=0.001.

effective_speed_floor.definition: max reach / step time = 20015 km / (6 h) = 0.927 km/s.
effective_speed_floor.why_lower_bound: This treats the antipodal reach as if it took the full 6 h step to arrive. But the influence is GLOBAL within a SINGLE indivisible model timestep, so the step time is an upper bound on the true travel time; the true effective speed is not resolvable below the model's 6 h resolution. The honest statement is that the effective Lieb-Robinson velocity is UNBOUNDED at the model's timestep resolution; 0.927 km/s is the floor implied by the largest distance and the coarsest possible travel time.

effective_lieb_robinson_velocity.value: unbounded at the model's 6 h timestep resolution
effective_lieb_robinson_velocity.explanation: A single forward step couples every grid point to every other via the AFNO global 2D rFFT token mixing; the model has no notion of a sub-step delay, so it imposes no finite signal-propagation speed within a step. Floor = 0.927 km/s; the model places no ceiling.

advective_100ms.comment: Generous upper bound on advective / jet-stream transport speed.

gravity_sound_300ms.comment: Generous upper bound covering fast gravity waves and the speed of sound (~340 m/s).

ratios.comment: Even the FLOOR estimate exceeds the most generous physical signal speed by ~3x; the reach exceeds the gravity-wave cone radius by ~3x and the advective cone radius by ~9x. Because the true speed is unbounded at timestep resolution, these ratios are themselves lower bounds.

out_of_cone_response.energy_caveat: The out-of-cone ENERGY is modest: ~9% beyond the 100 m/s cone and ~4% beyond the 300 m/s cone (response energy concentrates near the source). The acausal signature lives in the REACH (global in one step, 97% of the response AREA beyond the advective cone), not in the bulk energy. The wow is about how FAR the influence reaches, not how MUCH amplitude arrives there.

honest_caveats: Effective-speed framing is about REACH, not energy: the amplitude arriving at the antipode is small (out-of-cone energy ~4-9%) but nonzero, and a finite-domain-of-dependence PDE forbids it entirely at this lead time.
0.927 km/s is a FLOOR; the true effective velocity is unbounded at the 6 h timestep resolution because the coupling is instantaneous within a step.
Physical-cone speeds (100, 300 m/s) are themselves generous upper bounds on real atmospheric signal speeds; the model exceeds even these.
The model PASSES standard validation (t2m +6h wRMSE 2.32 K beats persistence), so this is an acausal regime inside an operationally skillful, deployed model, not an artifact of a broken model.
Numerical control is exactly 0 (deterministic eval), so the global response is genuine model influence, not floating-point noise.
